props.headline: Beautiful things made slowly by hand.
props.description: A collaborative showcase of independent New Zealand potters, weavers, and artists based in the heart of Wanaka.

items.title: Studio pottery
items.description: Tactile, functional stoneware and porcelain thrown by hand in local studios.

items.title: Woven textiles
items.description: Throws, cushions, and linen dyed with natural botanicals and hand-woven.

items.title: Artisan workshops
items.description: Hands-on weekend classes teaching pottery, clay sculpting, and traditional weaving.

props.title: Connecting local makers with people who care.
props.body: We believe the objects in our homes should carry stories. Kōwhai Craft Collective brings together independent South Island artists who share a deep respect for natural materials, sustainable practices, and timeless craft.

items.quote: A stunning collection of unique pieces. I've bought several mugs and a gorgeous linen throw that I cherish.
items.author: Sophia Morris

items.quote: It is wonderful to have a space that truly values and supports independent New Zealand artisans.
items.author: David Taylor
